ghar.createRoom: Ghar dropped rooms and went tags-only; its /rooms routes are gone.
ghar.deleteRoom: Ghar dropped rooms and went tags-only; its /rooms routes are gone.
ghar.listRooms: Ghar dropped rooms and went tags-only; its /rooms routes are gone.
ghar.moveDevice: A device has no room to move to; tags replace it (setDeviceTags, addTagDevices, removeTagDevice).
yaad.getNode: The session popover replaced the connections popover, which was the only reader of a node; a session now offers Show in Yaad instead.
hath.getAgentLogs: The popover read raw log rows only to guess wakes; Hath now serves wakes directly (listWakes, getWake, getLog) and rejects the wakes parameter.
ghar.renameRoom: Ghar dropped rooms and went tags-only; renameTag renames a tag.
hath.listSchedules: Hath replaced scheduled messages with routines and reminders; listRoutines reads them.
hath.patchSchedule: Routines and reminders have no PATCH: a routine is changed only by its own agent, so editing is a message to the agent.
hath.cancelSchedule: Ankur cancels a routine or a reminder instead: cancelRoutine and cancelReminder.
yaad.query: Home's Yaad tile paged every kind through POST /query to count it; Yaad now serves the counts and the total of every node in one GET /counts (counts).
hath.attachmentUrl: Attachments no longer exist: files are plain files on the box and messages carry box:// links, previewed from Nas /fs/raw (nas.fileUrl).
hath.getAttachmentBlob: Attachments no longer exist: a file is saved from its box path (nas.getFileBlob).
hath.getAttachmentText: Attachments no longer exist: a text file is read from its box path (nas.getFileText).
